description.narrative: ONG Actions de développement et de protection AER The present action supported by the NGO consortium AER and Leadership Challenges is in line with the objectives of the call for proposals in that it is focused on finding solutions to the problems and challenges facing young people and women with a view to their full participation in decision-making bodies for inclusive, participatory and sustainable development. Its objectives are as follows:Overall objective:Contribute to the promotion of inclusive and accountable localgovernance through the effective and sustainable civic participation of women and young people in the regions of Niamey, Maradi andTillabéry by building their capacities and supporting them.Specific objectives : Promote leadership and civic engagement among young people and women in the communes of Tillabery, Kourthey and Kollo (Tillabéry region) and the communes of Giratahoua, Safo and Tibiri.  Promote the creation of an environment conducive to inclusive and accountable governancethrough increased civic participationby women and young people in decision-making bodies and local development actions. Expected results (intermediate outcomes)  Youngpeople and women benefiting from the project have learned about their main rights and duties, the qualities of a good leader, the mechanisms of citizen control of public action (CCAP) and the challenges of citizen participation and commitment.  The concerns of young people and women are sufficiently taken into account by communal authorities in their planning and budgeting.Outputs: P1: 100 young people and women from the project's six (6) intervention communes are empowered in their rights and duties, leadership, citizen control of public action (CCAP) and citizen participation and commitment. P2: 12 women's and youth structures, 2 per commune, have carried out local civic initiatives (sanitation, tree planting, anti-civism awareness-raising, radio broadcasts, discussion forums, etc.). P3: 6 communes involved in the project are experimenting with Participatory Budgeting (PB), have a Resource Mobilization Strategy (RMS) and a Visible Service Improvement (VSI) strategy. P4: 6 communal budget and Annual Investment Plan (AIP) projects in the project's intervention communes take into account the concerns and priority needs of women and young people. Firstly, the present project is relevant in that it will contribute to the achievement and attainment of the objectives of the mother project led by the Oxfam ROTAB consortium, and will improve the participation of women's and young people's organizations based in the intervention communes, especially in citizen control of public action for inclusive and accountable local development. It will also contribute to strengthening the technical, operational and organizational capacities of the NGO AER-Leadership Challenges consortium, through the acquisition of operating equipment and the experience it will gain in implementing such a project. The project is also relevant in that it aims to support youth and women's organizations in the communes of Maradi and Tillabéry, not only in terms of technical, organizational and operational capacity-building, but also and above all in terms of involving these young people and women with initiatives in decision-making bodies, thereby encouraging their participation in development actions, a guarantee of the promotion of goodlocal governance and citizen participation. It will also help build trust between local authorities and civil society organizationsin general, and those led by young people and women in particular. Indeed, through the implementation of this project, the NGO consortium AER-Leadership Challenges will lead communal authorities to lay the foundations for good local governance, gender promotion, participation and inclusion. Indeed, this project's mission is to carry out actions in the field of capacity building for target groups, advocacy and improving relations between communal authorities and local civil society.These actions will undoubtedly contributeto the achievement of the mother project's results, of course those of improving the participation of grassroots community organizations (women and young people) in the citizen control of local public action. The effects of this project will be seen in the changein attitudes towards the rights of young people and women, the promotion of good local governance and gender, the involvement of young people and women in decision-making bodies, and above all their participation in development actions such as the organization ofclean-up operations, awareness-raising sessions on fiscal incivism and many other issues facing the target communes.Once the project is up and running, relations between local authorities and civil society will improve.This could have a positive impact on the living conditions of the population in general, and women and young people in particular. Young people and women will also be able to assert their leadership role thanks to the capacity-building sessions they willbenefit from.
